notes: PROVISIONAL. The runtime closure below is written down but not yet resolved: every artifact list is empty and no digest is recorded, so the managed install refuses and says why. A maintainer on a machine that can reach pypi.org and huggingface.co runs tools/pin_pocket_models.py, which fills in filenames, byte counts and SHA-256 digests from the publishers and sets "pinned" to true. Until then Pocket installs only from a folder somebody filled themselves, and what they supply is checked against required_paths and has its digests recorded. This is GATE P-1: no unreviewed wheel is fetched dynamically, and an artifact this repository makes no claim about is an artifact it will not download.

runtime.attribution: PocketTTS by Kyutai. Package pocket-tts 3.0.2 from PyPI; PyPI provenance ties that release to upstream commit f5fa841aa8702d7f15ea9e344bec5290bf42a446.
runtime.closure_notes: The smallest tested inference-complete closure rather than everything pocket-tts declares. Upstream's project metadata also lists a server and a CLI; the import path Voice Chat uses needs neither, and section 23.1 says the closure is the smallest tested inference-complete one. torchao is deliberately absent: INT8 quantization is offered only once GATE P-5 has measured it on release hardware, and adding an optional accelerator before then would be pinning a dependency nothing has run.

english.label: PocketTTS English
english.attribution: PocketTTS English by Kyutai. Public model assets from huggingface.co/kyutai/pocket-tts-without-voice-cloning; the voice-cloning weights are a separate gated repository whose conditions have to be accepted upstream.
english.summary: A streaming CPU model. Speaks with precomputed official voice states, and clones a voice from a short local recording once the gated weights are installed.
english.notes: Downloaded once and then read from disk. Voice Chat writes a local config whose every path names a verified local file, so nothing here is resolved again after installation and no hf:// or https:// location ever reaches the worker.
